cases.title: Add single and multiple notes successfully
cases.description: Preconditions: Application page is loaded. Action: Click the 'Add note' button (data-testid='add-note-button') once, and then test multiple rapid clicks. Expected Behavior: Each click appends a new div element with class 'note' containing a visible, empty textarea (data-testid='note-textarea') to the document body.

cases.title: Markdown rendering and invalid markdown handling
cases.description: Preconditions: A note is in edit mode with a visible textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'). Action: Type Markdown content or invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) and exit edit mode using the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button'). Expected Behavior: Valid Markdown renders in the main display area (data-testid='note-main'), invalid Markdown does not crash and displays raw input, and changes persist in local storage.

cases.title: Mode switching and automatic saving
cases.description: Preconditions: App page is loaded and a new note has been created. Action: Click the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button') to toggle between edit and view modes while typing into the textarea. Expected Behavior: The note defaults to edit mode upon creation with textarea visible and main content hidden. Clicking the edit button toggles visibility between the textarea and main content area, and changes are automatically saved to local storage.

cases.title: Delete note from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Preconditions: At least one note exists with a delete button (data-testid='delete-note-button') and is stored in localStorage. Action: Click the delete button on the note. Expected Behavior: The note is immediately removed from the DOM and its entry is removed from localStorage.

cases.title: Load notes from localStorage on startup
cases.description: Preconditions: Notes are populated in localStorage or localStorage is empty. Action: Load the Notes App webpage. Expected Behavior: The app retrieves saved notes, dynamically creating note elements with tools, main div, and textarea. Notes with content show the main div with hidden textarea, empty notes show the textarea with hidden main div, and an empty localStorage results in no notes shown.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1: Preconditions: The application page is loaded. Action: Click the 'Add note' button (id='add', class='add', data-testid='add-note-button'). Expected Behavior: A new note is created and appended to the document body as a div element with the class 'note', containing a visible, empty textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'). For multiple rapid clicks on the 'Add note' button, each click creates a separate note with its own textarea. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2: Preconditions: A note exists and is in edit mode with a visible textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'). Action: Input Markdown content (e.g., # Heading, **bold**, _italic_, [link](...)) or invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) and exit edit mode by clicking the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button'). Expected Behavior: Content is dynamically rendered in the main display area (data-testid='note-main') with proper HTML formatting when in view mode; invalid Markdown does not cause crashes and displays raw input upon exiting edit mode; all changes are reflected immediately in local storage. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3: Preconditions: The app page is loaded. Action: Click the 'Add note' button (data-testid='add-note-button') to create a note, then click the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button') to toggle between edit and view modes. Expected Behavior: Upon creation, the note enters edit mode with the textarea (data-testid='note-textarea') visible and main content area (data-testid='note-main') hidden. Clicking the 'Edit' button switches modes: in view mode, the main content area is visible and textarea is hidden; in edit mode, the reverse applies. All typed changes are automatically saved to local storage. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4: Preconditions: At least one note with a delete button (data-testid='delete-note-button') exists and is stored in localStorage. Action: Click the 'Delete' button associated with the note. Expected Behavior: The targeted note is immediately removed from the DOM and its corresponding entry is removed from localStorage. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5: Preconditions: Notes are stored in localStorage or localStorage is empty when the webpage loads. Action: Load the Notes App webpage. Expected Behavior: The app retrieves saved notes from localStorage, creates a div element with class 'note', tools containing an 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button') and 'Delete' button (data-testid='delete-note-button'), a main content div (data-testid='note-main'), and a textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'). Notes with content display content in the main div with the textarea hidden by default; notes with no content show the textarea and hide the main div; if localStorage is empty, no notes are shown.
